200 Returned if Tenable PCI ASV successfully retrieved the list of assets for the PCI attestation.
— 400 Returned if you do not have a license to use Tenable PCI ASV.
— 403
Returned if you do not have the required permissions to view the list of assets for the attestation. For
example, if you're an analyst user instead of an administrator.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in Tenable PCI ASV.
